text: A Psalm of David. 1 An utterance of YHWH to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
YHWH sends forth the rod of your strength from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies!”
Your people [are] freewill offerings in the day of your might, in the splendors of holiness; from the womb of the morning, the dew of your youth [is] unto you.
YHWH has sworn, and He will not change His mind: “You [are] a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
My Lord [is] at Your right hand; he will shatter kings in the day of his anger;
He will judge among the nations, he will fill it with corpses; he will wound the head of many lands;
from the brook by the way He will drink. By this He will lift up the head.
